# How to Get a Food Business License in Bangladesh: 2026 Step-by-Step Legal Process

Starting a restaurant, bakery, or packaged food brand in Bangladesh is a highly profitable venture, but navigating the legal landscape is critical. In 2026, regulatory compliance is heavily monitored by the government to ensure food safety and consumer trust. This guide provides a comprehensive, step-by-step roadmap on **how to get a food business license in Bangladesh**, backed by official statutory citations and a complete compliance checklist.

---

## Official Regulatory Authorities & Citations

To operate a food business legally, you must comply with the following statutory frameworks:

1. **The Food Safety Act, 2013**: Administered by the **Bangladesh Safe Food Authority (BFSA)**, governing kitchen hygiene, sanitation, and chemical standards.
2. **The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution (BSTI) Ordinance, 1985**: Governing packaged and processed food certifications.
3. **The Fire Prevention and Fire Fighting Act, 2003**: Governing safety clearances for commercial kitchens.
4. **Local Government (City Corporation) Act, 2009**: Governing municipal Trade Licenses.

---

## Step-by-Step Licensing Procedure

### Step 1: Secure a Commercial Trade License
Under the *Local Government (City Corporation) Act, 2009*, every business must obtain a Trade License from the local City Corporation (e.g., DNCC, DSCC) or Union Parishad. The license must explicitly mention 'Restaurant' or 'Food Manufacturing'.

### Step 2: VAT Registration (BIN)
Register for Value Added Tax (VAT) with the **National Board of Revenue (NBR)** to obtain a 9-digit Business Identification Number (BIN) under the *Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012*.

### Step 3: Bangladesh Safe Food Authority (BFSA) Registration
Under the *Food Safety Act, 2013*, you must register your establishment with the BFSA. They will conduct physical kitchen inspections focusing on **HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point)** principles.

At [Culinary Academy](/en/about), we prepare our entrepreneur students to meet these inspections through our [Professional Chef Courses](/en/courses), which cover commercial kitchen hygiene and safety protocols.

### Step 4: BSTI Certification (For Packaged/Processed Foods)
Under the *BSTI Ordinance, 1985*, if you plan to package food (e.g., sauces, spice mixes, frozen items), you must submit samples to BSTI labs for chemical and microbiological testing to obtain the BSTI Standard Mark.

### Step 5: Environmental & Fire Clearance Certificate
Commercial kitchens must obtain:
- **Fire License** from Fire Service and Civil Defence (FSCD).
- **Environmental Clearance Certificate (ECC)** from the Department of Environment (DoE) for solid and liquid waste management.

---

## Essential Document Checklist

Before applying for any license, make sure you have the following documents ready:

- [ ] Commercial space lease agreement (Minimum 2 years) or Land Registry docs
- [ ] National ID Card (NID) of the Owner(s)
- [ ] 3 Passport-sized photos of the applicant
- [ ] Tax Identification Number (TIN) Certificate
- [ ] Articles of Association & Incorporation Certificate (For Limited Companies)
- [ ] Safe Food Officer training certificate (Can be obtained through training at Culinary Academy)
- [ ] Fire safety layout design of the kitchen
- [ ] Product recipe breakdown and chemical analysis report (For BSTI)

---

## Downloadable Documents & Authority Portals

| Document / Portal | Issuing Authority | Official Web Portal Link | Fee Range (Est.) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Online Trade License** | City Corporation | [e-trade.gov.bd](http://www.etradelicense.gov.bd) | BDT 5,000 - 15,000 |
| **VAT (BIN) Registration** | National Board of Revenue | [vat.gov.bd](https://vat.gov.bd) | Free |
| **BSTI Product Certification** | BSTI | [bsti.gov.bd](http://www.bsti.gov.bd) | BDT 10,000 - 30,000 |
| **Safe Food Registration** | BFSA | [bfsa.gov.bd](http://www.bfsa.gov.bd) | BDT 2,000 - 5,000 |
| **Fire License Application** | Fire Service & Civil Defence | [fscd.gov.bd](http://www.fscd.gov.bd) | BDT 8,000 - 20,000 |

---
